name: Entropy-Calibrated Effective-Number
tagline: Binary-search the power on effective-number weights so the reweighted class distribution hits a target entropy.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the fixed sqrt-dampening on inverse-frequency / effective-number weights with an entropy-calibration loop that picks the power α via binary search so the reweighted distribution achieves a target effective entropy (relative to log C) — none of the baselines tune the power class-wise or by entropy.

name: Piecewise Effective Weighting (PEW)
tagline: Effective-number weights, but only classes below the median count receive a >1 weight; head/median classes are pinned to 1.
init_recovers: Effective-Number baseline (Cui) when normalised against median weight, but with head classes flattened to 1.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to plain effective-number weighting, only the below-median classes get a >1 weight (relative to the median's effective weight), while head classes stay at 1 — a piecewise variant of class-balanced weighting that avoids amplifying any head-side gradient.

name: Smooth Cosine Log-Gap Weighting
tagline: Raised-cosine S-curve over the log-frequency rank with peak weight √(imbalance_ratio).
formula: $$x_c = \frac{\log n_{\max} - \log n_c}{\log n_{\max} - \log n_{\min}},\quad s(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}(1 - \cos\pi x),\quad w_c = 1 + (\sqrt{\rho} - 1)\,s(x_c),\quad w \leftarrow \frac{C\,w}{\sum w_{c'}}$$
init_recovers: Uniform weights when n_max = n_min (degenerate balanced case).
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the linear log-gap weighting (Balanced-Softmax baseline) with a raised-cosine S-curve over the normalised log-frequency rank, and sets the max weight to √(imbalance_ratio) instead of a fixed 5×; yields a smoother head→tail interpolation than power/effective-number baselines.

name: Granularity-Adaptive Reliability Reweighting
tagline: Severity- and arch-tuned power on shrunk effective counts, with a mid-tail bump scaled by class granularity.
formula: $$\tilde{n}_c = n_c + \lambda \sqrt{n_c\,\bar{n}},\quad r_c = \tfrac{\log n_{\max} - \log n_c}{\log n_{\max} - \log n_{\min}},\quad p_c = p_0\,(1 + g\cdot 4 r_c(1-r_c))$$$$w_c = (\bar{n}/\tilde{n}_c)^{p_c},\quad w \leftarrow \tfrac{C\,w}{\sum w_{c'}}$$

key_hyperparams.name: p₀ (base power)
key_hyperparams.role: global power on inverse effective count

diff_from_baseline: Generalises sqrt-inverse-frequency (power=0.5) and effective-number (power=1) into a per-class power that depends on imbalance severity, tail reliability, granularity (10/C), and whether the architecture is VGG; effective counts are also shrunk towards the mean by λ√(n·n̄) — none of the named baselines vary the power per class or per architecture.

name: Log-Frequency Linear Interpolation
tagline: Linearly interpolate weights from 1 (head) to √(imbalance_ratio) (rarest) along normalised log-frequency.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the Balanced-Softmax-style 1+α·gap (max gap fixed at 4) with a linear interpolation from 1 to √(imbalance_ratio) over the normalised log-frequency gap, and replaces inverse-frequency / effective-number power-law weights with a strictly linear-in-log-freq ramp.
